title: Count step-level dependencies in queue order
goal: A record that waits on a step of another record orders like one with a record-level dependency, without changing its lane.
acceptance: A committed test fails without the fix
The prerequisite moves above its first dependent and gets credit for what it unblocks; closed prerequisite steps count nothing
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: extra dependencies in one ranking function.
